newsitem.title: USA: PSA, NFMA to hold muni disclosure session April 17.
newsitem.headline: PSA, NFMA to hold muni disclosure session April 17.

text.p: The Public Securities Association and National Federation of Municipal Analysts plan to hold a two-hour, nationwide symposium on April 17 on how well the SEC's municipal disclosure rule is working, PSA said.

Approved by the Securities and Exchange Commission in November 1994, Rule 15c2-12 bars dealers from underwriting bonds unless the issuer pledges to provide ongoing disclosure of annual financial information and material events.
Dealers must have systems in place to monitor material events that could impact the bonds they recommend to buyers.
Bond analysts are expected to warn at an upcoming meeting with SEC officials and staff that some bond issuers are not complying with the letter or spirit of the commission's rule.

PSA said people can attend the session at PSA headquarters in New York or phone in questions live to panel participants, including representatives of dealers, investors, issuers and repositories. PSA said it also will encourage federal regulators to attend.
This will be a "huge pooling of what's going on, what's working, where are the concerns," said PSA senior vice president Caroline Benn.
